title: invoicecreationandediting
description: Test the primary invoice creation and editing functionality by entering invoice header details, business and client information, adding line items, and verifying live preview updates and PDF download.

title: pricingtaxtaxdiscountshippingandcurrencycontrols
description: Verify tax, discount, shipping, and currency controls by applying various rates and charges, checking recalculated totals, and ensuring correct currency formatting in the invoice preview.

title: logouploadandvisualbranding
description: Test uploading and removing a company logo on the invoice, verifying the logo appears and disappears correctly in the live preview and PDF export.

title: templateswitchingandlivepreview
description: Validate switching between different invoice templates retains all entered data intact and updates the live preview accordingly, including on mobile layouts.

title: pdfdownloadandprinting
description: Test generating and downloading the invoice as a PDF file and triggering the browser print dialog from the invoice page.

title: browserdraftsavingandreset
description: Verify that invoice data is automatically saved in browser localStorage, restored on page refresh, and can be cleared with confirmation to reset the form.

title: freelancerinvoicetemplate
description: Test the freelancer invoice template by entering project and billing details, adding rates and payment terms, and downloading the invoice PDF.

title: contractorinvoicetemplate
description: Validate the contractor invoice template by entering labor and material costs, verifying separated totals, and downloading the contractor invoice PDF.

title: australiantaxinvoicetemplate
description: Test the Australian tax invoice template by entering ABN, adding invoice items, verifying automatic 10% GST calculation, and downloading the compliant PDF.

title: receiptgenerator
description: Verify the sales receipt generator by selecting payment method, entering transaction details and itemized lines, and downloading the receipt as a PDF.
